name: Avaro
source:
A half-elf technomancer is descended from a human father and an elf mother and is an apostle of the goddess of the bonds.
After his previous adventures, Guaracuna Castle lost its ability to move independently. So, he spent his days working in his workshop to restore its functionality. However, when he encountered the spirit Kuna, the repair work on the fort came to a halt. To adapt to the land of magicians, he improved his shaft technology and created an enhanced shaft hammer that also functioned as a magic staff.
Also, he is deeply interested in the mechanism of large-scale teleportation magic, which is considered to be Mephi's hidden treasure. He is thinking about whether he can analyze its mechanism and incorporate it into his own technique.
Since having his own workshop, which was his dream, he has become even more responsible and like a big brother, especially towards those who depend on him. Working in the workshop has significantly improved his technical skills, and he finds joy and purpose in seeing people smile because of his creations.
